extensionDescription.message: Detect prompt injection, optional PII overfill, and privacy traps on pages used by AI agents.

mailScope.message: Candidate Gmail and Outlook web adapters; real-mailbox acceptance is incomplete.

mailPrivacy.message: Content is checked only in this page. New mail records omit bodies, subjects, addresses and filenames, with no desktop forwarding.

mailAttachments.message: File contents cannot be checked yet: recognized file selection, drop, paste and sends with attachments are blocked while enabled.

mailBoundary.message: Does not cover direct APIs, automatic draft syncing, desktop clients or every web action. No one-time release or automatic sending.

mailOff.message: Off by default. Review the scope in Mail settings before enabling.

mailUnavailable.message: Mail settings are unavailable; page checks cannot be confirmed.

mailOtherPage.message: Enabled in settings; this page is outside the Gmail/Outlook mail adapters.

mailNoPage.message: Enabled in settings, but the page connection is unconfirmed. Reload the mailbox and retry.

mailOnCandidate.message: Page checks enabled for {provider} (experimental, not full coverage).

mailSaveError.message: Settings could not be saved. Please retry.

nativeForward.message: Connect the desktop app for stronger protection (optional)

nativeForwardHint.message: With the desktop app connected, blocking decisions are also signed into the local audit log, and malicious sites are blocked on desktop too.

allClear.message: No recent records. This does not mean every page or action was checked. When an action is blocked, its reason appears here.

noBlocked.message: No sites are blocked right now

obLede.message: AgentGuard watches what AI agents do in your browser and blocks supported risky steps before they happen.

obP1Body.message: Pages can hide instructions meant for AI agents in invisible text. AgentGuard finds them and tells you.

obP2Title.message: Blocks supported money and personal-info actions

obP2Body.message: A recognized payment click or privacy-trap form is stopped. A web page cannot release it.

obP3Title.message: Blocks known bad sites at the network level

obP3Body.message: Requests to known malicious sites are stopped in the browser itself. You can see and undo every block from the toolbar popup.

obDemoTitle.message: See it once, so it never surprises you

obDemoBody.message: Click the fake payment button below. No payment exists and nothing is sent. The notice has no allow control; closing it does not release the action.

obDemoCancelled.message: Notice closed. The action remains blocked.

obMorePopup.message: The toolbar popup shows what was found and blocked today, in plain words. Technical details stay one tap away under "Why?".

obMoreDesktop.message: Native Messaging is disabled in the first GA package while its trust boundary is hardened.

obPrivacy.message: Findings stay on your device by default. Nothing is uploaded.

linkOff.message: Desktop forwarding is off — findings stay in this browser.

linkTo.message: Forwarding to the desktop app on this computer ({host})

checkingNone.message: Not a web page — nothing to check here.
